steps: Picked Bab al-Mandab Burning as Saudi Arabia from the title globe
Took office, read mission, tapped Approve 4 then Execute
Read month debrief, newspaper, kept going through hostage, sanctions and scandal crises
scenarios.notes: Play felt good but I never learned how I was doing against the mission (2/4 stayed 2/4). Wall time per month was far beyond 90 s on a loaded host (load average above 100), so pace could not be judged cleanly.

steps: Stopped at month 5 (Feb 2027), tapped the Mission pill twice, nothing opened
scenarios.notes: Did not reach the 12-month end, so I do not know why I would win or lose.

friction.happened: The same sentence appears three times (italic intro, mission box, crisis blurb), starting with 'You are Crown Prince and Prime Minister' twice in a row

friction.expected: Tap shows my goal and progress
friction.happened: Reads 'Mission 2/4 - 9 mo' but 2/4 of what is not explained; tapping the pill (twice) opened nothing I could see; the pill and the crisis chip run off the right edge

friction.expected: Clear confirmation of what was approved
friction.happened: The Approve button vanished and the staff-pick badge became 'Your call'; I could not tell if my pick was kept; Execute button looked clipped
Each month is Execute, then 3 debrief pages, then a newspaper to scroll, then 'To your desk': about 5 taps and scrolls; Diplomacy page, newspaper both long
Houthi and Trump both said 'Good. Words like these travel fast in ... Do not make me regret them.' and both headlines 'takes the call, and keeps the door ajar'. Repeated text is my deal breaker.

friction.where: Debrief crisis card for special forces
friction.happened: Card showed a red X and 'This will come back', no outcome; I learned the hostages came home only from the newspaper next month
Tapping the tab labels did not navigate; only the bottom button worked
'Noted and filed. The machinery of government turns.' reads like filler
Screenshots and taps often took 30 s or more (host load average above 100), page seemed to hang between steps

bugs.title: Mission pill tap does nothing visible, text clipped at right edge on phone
steps: Tap the Mission pill at the top
bugs.actual: No visible change; pill and chip overflow the screen width

bugs.title: Debrief tab chips do not navigate on tap
Duplicate mission sentence on intro screen
bugs.actual: First sentence repeated, and the same paragraph shown twice

suggestions.what: Put a one-line goal with progress bar ('End the war: 0 of 2 done') on the desk, tappable, never clipped
Show the outcome of the crisis choice in the debrief card (raid succeeded or failed), not only world tension
Make one Execute tap show a single short result card, then the next desk; fold the newspaper in as optional
Vary the diplomatic reply lines per leader

delight: Title globe with Today crisis and 15 MIN tab: I knew where to tap in a second (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/maya-phone/001-title.png)
Staff pre-fills picks and one Approve button, so I never needed a manual (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/maya-phone/003-s2.png)
Summit and crisis illustrations feel like a real game (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/maya-phone/009-m4.png)
Newspaper front page is charming and told me the hostages were freed (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/maya-phone/038-e4.png)
War with Yemen ended in the first month, a quick, satisfying win (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/maya-phone/005-m1.png)

fun.reason: Quick, good looking, a first month win and a hostage raid. Dampened by the long loop per month.

clarity.reason: Desk is clear about what to do next, but the mission and 'am I winning' are not; repeated text.

visual.reason: Illustrated scenes, newspaper, clear type; only edge clipping on the top pills.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Cards, staff picks and scenes feel crafted; the debrief stack and number tiles still feel like reports.

agency.reason: Never hard blocked, but the dead Mission pill and unclear result of my choices left me guessing.

realism.reason: Houthi talks, hostage raid and sanctions vote feel topical; the stock quotes break it.

replay.reason: I would try another flashpoint once if the month loop were shorter.

recommend.reason: I would send it to a friend who likes Reigns, with the warning that it is a lot of tapping per month.

quit_point: Month 5 (Feb 2027), after tapping the Mission pill twice with no response and still not knowing what 2/4 means, on top of the repeated 'Words like these travel fast' reply and a month taking five-plus screens
verbatim: It looks great and the staff does the thinking, but I still can't tell if I'm winning, and every month is five screens too long.
